The published bottom-only slip contains the type bar, game text, concept credit and Set 7 symbol; it omits the title header, lore and artwork. The title, destiny and lore listed here are retained from the preceding full-card image shown in the comparison; they are not reproduced on this slip. This is documented image 6 (Errata 5); the source prints “E1”. The image-version ordinal and actual printed mark are recorded separately in [[Players Committee transcription errors]].<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-7-September-2023.pdf|Official Set 7 sheet, September 2023 edition]], page 3.</ref>
* '''Original''' ([[They're Tracking Us (V)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-theyretrackingusv022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/theyretrackingus.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/theyretrackingus.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•They’re Tracking Us”. Text: “Cancel Program Trap; droid it was deployed on may be taken into owner's hand. [Immune to Sense.] OR Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. OR Activate 1 Force.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[They're Tracking Us (V) (Errata)]]): Errata-sheet slip, Errata Sheet 2021 Summer (official text as of 23 June 2021)<ref name="sheet-2021-06-22">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/errata_062321.pdf Errata Sheet 2021 Summer] (Players Committee), page 1; PDF built 22 June 2021. Listed on the PC's [https://web.archive.org/web/20240920164229/https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual slips page] (Internet Archive, 20 September 2024).</ref> — the cut-out slip the PC published for sleeving over the card (an errata-sheet slip is its own version, separate from the PC card image of the same errata; Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed:''' the card type “Used Interrupt” became “Used or Lost Interrupt”; “Cancel Program Trap; droid it was deployed on may be taken into owner's hand. [Immune to Sense.] OR Add or” → “USED: Add or”; “1 Force.” → “1 Force. LOST: Cancel Close Call, Gravity Shadow, Overwhelmed, or They've Shut Down The Main Reactor. [Immune to Sense.]”; the errata mark “E1” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); the bottom margin “•They’re Tracking Us” → “They’re Tracking Us” (uniqueness dot removed); this version is the errata-sheet slip (a different printing from the card image before it). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “They’re Tracking Us”. Text: “USED: Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. OR Activate 1 Force. LOST: Cancel Close Call, Gravity Shadow, Overwhelmed, or They've Shut Down The Main Reactor. [Immune to Sense.]”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[They're Tracking Us (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 22 June 2021<ref name="img-theyretrackingusv30816d1">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/theyretrackingus.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/commits/30816d1eceffdd0a07a5af277fcbcbc9fc96f665 commit 30816d1] (22 June 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/theyretrackingus.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' this version is the PC card image (the previous version was the errata-sheet slip); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “They’re Tracking Us”. Text: “USED: Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. OR Activate 1 Force. LOST: Cancel Close Call, Gravity Shadow, Overwhelmed, or They've Shut Down The Main Reactor. [Immune to Sense.]” On 5 July 2022 the PC re-uploaded this image as a 703×980-pixel PNG<ref name="img-theyretrackingusva41bae9">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/theyretrackingus.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe commit a41bae9] (5 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/theyretrackingus.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> ([[:File:V7-L-Theyre_Tracking_Us_(V)-2022-07-05-a41bae9.png]]). Scaled to the same size, it is the same image, with the same corners, border, credit line, picture, words and mark; only the size and file format differ. A re-hosted copy is a note on the printing it shows, not a separate version (Bill, 25 November 2026).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[They're Tracking Us (V) (Errata 3)]]): PC card image uploaded 4 November 2022<ref name="img-theyretrackingusva57375e">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/theyretrackingus.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a57375eaf483d0e05592c08185b77505a415f0e5 commit a57375e] (4 November 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/theyretrackingus.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (703×980 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “They’re Tracking Us”. It is the current full-face image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “USED: Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. OR Activate 1 Force. LOST: Cancel Close Call, Gravity Shadow, Overwhelmed, or They've Shut Down The Main Reactor. [Immune to Sense.]”
